ideia: E02 (teste do fluxo com imagem gerada): a confraternização que a empresa pagou e não guardou

imagens.cena: a company year-end party at night, a round table of colleagues of clearly different ages and ethnicities (a Black woman in her fifties, a young East Asian man, a gray-haired white man, a Latina woman in her thirties) laughing together, one of them raising a phone toward the stage, seen from behind their shoulders, the phone held so its screen faces away from the camera, the stage itself out of frame so only its warm glow reaches the room
